messages:
sophie: Heads-up — CI integration pipeline is red, ~30 session-store tests failing across multiple jobs since ~10:02am. Seeing a lot of Redis connection errors.
rahul: Link? I can grab logs and bisect quickly.
sophie: job page: https://ci.internal/redwood/1123
ci-bot: Job #1123 failed: session-store.integration (tests: 28 failures) — https://ci.internal/redwood/1123 (automated)
kevin: quick grep of logs shows a bunch of `ECONNRESET` and `READONLY You can't write against a read only replica` lines.
sophie: paste of a snippet:
```
ERROR session-store: redis error: read ECONNRESET
at TCP.onStreamRead (internal/stream_base_commons.js:205:27)
Caused by: ERR max number of clients reached
```
marta: saw the mock-redis pod restart loop on node ci-node-7 a few mins ago. RestartCount 5.
devops-bot: Alert: node ci-node-7 disk pressure (eviction) — investigating.
kevin: if node had disk pressure redis might be killed/readonly during R/W. Can we spin test jobs away from that node or restart the mock statefulset?
rahul: propose bisect: run failing test file locally against mocked redis image pinned to v1.2.0 vs latest to see regression. Anyone can trigger a rerun with image override?
marta: I can edit the ci-mocks statefulset to increase resources and restart. Command I ran: `kubectl -n ci-mocks set image sts/mock-redis mock-redis=redwood/mock-redis:v1.2.0` and `kubectl rollout restart sts/mock-redis -n ci-mocks`
kevin: alternatively, quick workaround for the pipeline: set TEST_REDIS_URL to `redis://staging-redis.internal:6379` in the job to bypass ci-mocks while we stabilize.
sophie: we need an unblock asap — can you do a quick rerun after the rollout? if that clears, we'll leave the rerun results and revert the image change later.
marta: rolling now, pods terminating and coming back up. I'll post when all ready.
ci-bot: Rerun requested: Job #1123 rerun-by=marta (queued)
rahul: I'll start a local bisect while that runs — if it's infra we should see green after rollout.
devops-bot: Node ci-node-7 shows kubelet evicting pods due to ephemeral disk full. Cleaning up and cordoning node for maintenance.
kevin: pinging @infra-team to avoid scheduling future ci-mocks to ci-node-7: `kubectl cordon ci-node-7` and add nodeSelector to CI DaemonSet if needed.
sophie: thanks. quick ask: can we add a flaky annotation to the most noisy tests so they don't block the release if this recurs? we can follow-up with a proper fix.
rahul: will open a small PR to mark the top 10 flakes as `ci/flake` and add a note linking to this thread.
marta: rollout finished — mock-redis pods back with new image v1.2.0 and Ready=1/1 across 3 replicas.
ci-bot: Job #1123 rerun started.
kevin: initial rerun logs show connections stable, first batch of tests passing.
ci-bot: Job #1123 rerun succeeded (all session-store tests passed).
sophie: awesome — leaving this thread open for a bit. @devops-bot can you confirm node remediation done and mark any follow-up tickets?
devops-bot: Node cordoned and OS cleanup started; will open infra ticket INFRA-679 for disk-pressure root cause and keep this thread updated.
sophie: thanks everyone :thumbsup: we can proceed with release once infra ticket has owners and the bisect if it finds any regression will be in rahul's PR.
